level_i.what_could_constitute_proof: Detection of primordial gravitational waves (r > 0.001) + cosmic flatness
level_i.actually_proves: Inflation, not multiverse directly - multiverse is consequence
level_i.falsifiability: Detection of curvature Omega_k != 0 undermines inflation -> undermines Level I

level_ii.what_could_constitute_proof: Resolution of measure problem + unique testable predictions + bubble collision detection
level_ii.feasibility: Measure problem likely structural - 30+ years no consensus
level_ii.actually_proves: Cannot yet - measure problem blocks all unique predictions
level_ii.falsifiability: Bubble collision signatures in CMB (PIXIE/PRISM concept, not yet funded)

level_iii.what_could_constitute_proof: IMPOSSIBLE - interpretations empirically equivalent by construction
level_iii.feasibility: Never - all interpretations (Copenhagen, Bohm, QBism, etc.) give identical predictions
level_iii.actually_proves: Category error - MWI is interpretation not theory
level_iii.falsifiability: No experiment can distinguish MWI from alternatives

level_iv.feasibility: Never - no observation can contradict "all mathematical structures exist"
level_iv.actually_proves: Category error - Level IV is metaphysics not physics

synthesis.master_category_error: "The multiverse" is not a single hypothesis but four fundamentally different claims
conflation_errors: Treating MWI (interpretation) as scientific theory that can be proven
Treating Level IV (metaphysics) as physical theory
Confusing evidence for inflation (precursor theory) with evidence for multiverse
Confusing post-diction (explaining fine-tuning after the fact) with prediction (anticipating unknown)
Assuming measure exists when it structurally cannot be derived in eternal inflation
synthesis.honest_assessment: The question "Prove the multiverse exists" is malformed - contains multiple category errors
what_can_be_said: Level I: Plausible consequence of leading cosmological theory (inflation)
Level II: Speculative theoretical consequence with unsolved foundational problems (measure)
Level III: Interpretation of QM, not theory - outside realm of proof
Level IV: Metaphysics, not physics - fundamentally unfalsifiable
synthesis.conclusion: Anyone claiming to "prove the multiverse" is either conflating categories, confusing interpretation with theory, or doing philosophy while calling it science
